RSL Music Journey — UX direction
DISCOVER → DECIDE → GO (not search → filter → sort → manage)

1 · HOME
One dominant invitation, not a 4-button menu.

2 · WHAT ARE YOU FEELING
Mood tiles + artists + DJ/LIVE/HYBRID. Not a settings form.

3 · ADVENTUROUS / TIME / WHERE
One slider, one chip row, one field. Then go.

4 · YOUR NIGHT
A journey timeline with a narrative thread, not a list of cards.

5 · ACT DETAIL
Tap any act. Unknown never means bad.
